title: Jonah's Prayer

questions.question: From where did Jonah pray to the Lord his God?
questions.explanation: Jonah 2:1 (ESV): "Then Jonah prayed to the Lord his God from the belly of the fish,"

questions.question: Who did Jonah say answered him out of the belly of Sheol?
questions.explanation: Jonah 2:2 (ESV): "I called out to the Lord, out of my distress, and he answered me;"

questions.question: Jonah said the waters closed in over him to take his what?
questions.explanation: Jonah 2:5 (ESV): "The waters closed in over me to take my life;"

questions.question: What was wrapped about Jonah's head?
questions.explanation: Jonah 2:5 (ESV): "weeds were wrapped about my head"

questions.question: Where did the fish vomit Jonah out?
questions.explanation: Jonah 2:10 (ESV): "And the Lord spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah out upon the dry land."

questions.question: Those who pay regard to vain idols forsake their hope of what?
questions.explanation: Jonah 2:8 (ESV): "Those who pay regard to vain idols forsake their hope of steadfast love."

questions.question: Jonah said he would sacrifice to the Lord with the voice of what?
questions.explanation: Jonah 2:9 (ESV): "But I with the voice of thanksgiving will sacrifice to you;"

questions.question: I went down to the land whose bars closed upon me forever; yet you brought up my life from the what?
questions.explanation: Jonah 2:6 (ESV): "yet you brought up my life from the pit, O Lord my God."

questions.question: When my life was fainting away, I remembered whom?
questions.explanation: Jonah 2:7 (ESV): "When my life was fainting away, I remembered the Lord,"

questions.question: Jonah said his prayer came to the Lord, into his what?
questions.explanation: Jonah 2:7 (ESV): "and my prayer came to you, into your holy temple."

questions.question: For you cast me into the deep, into the heart of the seas, and the flood surrounded me; all your waves and your billows passed over me.
questions.explanation: Jonah 2:3 (ESV): "For you cast me into the deep, into the heart of the seas, and the flood surrounded me; all your waves and your billows passed over me."

questions.question: Then I said, "I am driven away from your sight; yet I shall again look upon..."?
questions.explanation: Jonah 2:4 (ESV): "yet I shall again look upon your holy temple."

questions.question: What did Jonah vow to do?
questions.explanation: Jonah 2:9 (ESV): "what I have vowed I will pay."

questions.question: I went down at the roots of the what?
questions.explanation: Jonah 2:6 (ESV): "at the roots of the mountains. I went down to the land whose bars closed upon me forever;"

key_verse_text: But I with the voice of thanksgiving will sacrifice to you; what I have vowed I will pay. Salvation belongs to the Lord!
